# The images the container-backed test stack pulls, each pinned by digest.
#
#   <name>  <upstream image, pinned by digest>  <the reference the stack asks for>
#
# .github/workflows/mirror-ci-images.yml copies each one to ghcr.io/kenstott/provisa/ci-<name>
# with its digest preserved, so the copy is the same image: ghcr.io/kenstott/provisa/ci-<name>@<digest>.
# In CI the test stack pulls the copy (tests/ci_images.py turns the reference a compose file or a
# test asks for into it); nowhere else is anything changed, and no file an install starts names
# a mirror. Layers are the registry's pieces: pulled in parallel, a shared layer stored once,
# and none of it counts against the repository's 10 GB of Actions cache.
#
# To move to a newer upstream image: change the digest here, start the mirror workflow, and the
# stack pulls the new image. A tag that moves upstream (`latest`) changes nothing here until then.
# To add an image the stack starts: add its line (the third column exactly as the compose file
# or the test writes it) and start the mirror workflow. An image a compose file BUILDS is not
# listed: it is built in the run.
#
# Digests as resolved 2026-10-10.
